identity.name: ClickFix Interpreter-Depth Loader Chain: mshta -> extrac32 CAB Unpack -> Masqueraded Signed AutoIt3 (.a3x) — Lumma Stealer ABIOC
identity.summary: Post-paste ClickFix loader chain delivering Lumma Stealer: mshta fetches an encoded downloader, a cmd.exe loader probes for AV/EDR (tasklist|findstr opssvc/wrsa), extrac32 unpacks a non-.cab archive (Boat.pst), and a signed AutoIt3 renamed Slovenia.com runs an .a3x script. Every binary is legitimate; the ABIOC fires on the causality chain, not a signature.
identity.description: This card gives the ENDPOINT plane depth on Execution (TA0002) beyond the initial-access ClickFix paste (covered by SIM-EDR-016). It models the DEPTH of the loader chain that runs AFTER a victim pastes the ClickFix command, as documented by Unit 42 for a Lumma Stealer campaign delivered via ClearFake/pastejacking. The tradecraft is entirely living-off-the-land: mshta.exe (a signed Microsoft binary) proxies a remote fetch of an encoded PowerShell downloader (T1218.014 / T1059.001); a cmd.exe loader stage (T1059.003) first runs a security-software discovery probe (tasklist | findstr /I "opssvc wrsa" and against bdservicehost/SophosHealth/AvastUI/AVGUI/nsWscSvc/ekrn — T1518.001); it stages a numbered working directory (cmd /c md 386354), then abuses extrac32.exe to unpack a Cabinet archive delivered under a benign extension (extrac32 /Y /E Boat.pst) and reassembles the payload from concatenated fragments via copy /b (T1140). The final and most important hop is masquerading: the loader reconstructs a legitimate, VALIDLY-SIGNED AutoIt3 interpreter, renames it Slovenia.com, and launches it against a compiled .a3x AutoIt script (start Slovenia.com G — T1036.005) that carries the Lumma Stealer payload. A hand-authored BIOC keyed on any single binary would miss this: extrac32, mshta, tasklist, findstr and AutoIt3 are all legitimate. The catch is behavioral — the ABIOC scores the CAUSALITY CHAIN (mshta remote fetch -> cmd loader -> AV probe -> extrac32 unpack -> signed AutoIt binary running under a non-standard image name) and groups two-or-more distinct loader stages into one Lumma-loader incident. Three ABIOCs document the deviation shapes (the mshta-fetch loader lineage and the extrac32->masqueraded-AutoIt3 grouping are model-only; the tasklist/findstr AV-discovery burst fires on real telemetry); validation XQLs surface the real benign extrac32 unpack and the AV-probe command line; an NDR hunt XQL surfaces the stager fetch (pub-*.r2.dev) and Lumma C2 egress (sumeriavgv[.]digital); and a correlation rule stitches the real endpoint LOLBin signal with the network egress into a single Lumma-loader incident spanning the EDR and NDR planes. Executed NON-DESTRUCTIVELY: the genuinely-benign discovery LOLBins (tasklist|findstr) AND a benign extrac32 /Y /E CAB unpack of a locally-authored archive run for REAL telemetry, while the mshta remote fetch, copy /b payload reconstruction, and the masqueraded signed-AutoIt3 interpreter execution are modelled with SAFE-MODE marker files only — no interpreter is reconstructed or run and no payload is fetched. Consequently the mshta-fetch loader ABIOC and the extrac32->masqueraded-AutoIt3 grouping ABIOC are MODEL-ONLY (documented for a full detonation, not asserted to fire under SAFE-MODE); the AV/EDR-discovery ABIOC and the extrac32-unpack validation XQL fire on the real telemetry the SAFE-MODE run does produce.

campaigns: ClickFix / ClearFake pastejacking delivering Lumma Stealer via a signed-AutoIt3 loader chain (2024-2026)

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-EDR-017 — ClickFix interpreter-depth Lumma loader chain modelled NON-DESTRUCTIVELY for Cortex ABIOC + cross-plane correlation validation.

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR / XSIAM Windows agent installed on the target so per-process, command-line, signer, and network telemetry reaches xdr_data.

payload.code:
# NON-DESTRUCTIVE model of the ClickFix Lumma loader chain. Only the
# genuinely-benign discovery LOLBins run for real; the archive unpack, payload
# reconstruction, and interpreter execution are SAFE-MODE marker files.
$stage = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'cortexsim-edr-017'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $stage | Out-Null
# (1) mshta remote fetch — modelled (no real fetch, no mshta invocation)
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $stage 'SAFE-MODE-mshta-fetch.marker') -Value 'CortexSim SIM-EDR-017 SAFE-MODE: models mshta.exe proxying a remote fetch of an encoded PowerShell downloader (e.g. mshta hxxps://iplogger[.]co/xxxxx =+). No fetch performed.'
# (2) AV/EDR product discovery — REAL benign LOLBins (harmless process listing)
cmd.exe /c "tasklist | findstr /I \"opssvc wrsa\"" | Out-Null
cmd.exe /c "tasklist | findstr /I \"bdservicehost SophosHealth AvastUI AVGUI nsWscSvc ekrn\"" | Out-Null
# (3) working-dir staging — REAL benign directory creation
cmd.exe /c "md $stage\386354" 2>$null
# (4) extrac32 CAB unpack — REAL but BENIGN: author a local CAB then unpack it
#     with extrac32 for genuine unpack telemetry (no malicious archive fetched).
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $stage 'benign-cab-input.txt') -Value 'CortexSim SIM-EDR-017 benign CAB payload — safe extrac32 telemetry only.'
Push-Location $stage
cmd.exe /c "makecab benign-cab-input.txt Boat.pst" | Out-Null
cmd.exe /c "extrac32 /Y /E Boat.pst /L 386354" | Out-Null
Pop-Location
# (5) copy /b payload reconstruction + masqueraded signed AutoIt3 — modelled (no exec)
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $stage 'SAFE-MODE-masqueraded-autoit3.marker') -Value 'CortexSim SIM-EDR-017 SAFE-MODE: a REAL benign extrac32 /Y /E ran against a locally-authored CAB (Boat.pst) for extrac32 telemetry; the copy /b reconstruction of the payload from concatenated fragments and a legitimate, validly-signed AutoIt3 interpreter renamed to Slovenia.com launched against a compiled .a3x script (start Slovenia.com G) are modelled only. No payload reconstructed, no interpreter run.'
# (6) optional egress SHAPE against an authorised host (no real C2/stager)
try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5 -Uri "http://$($env:CORTEXSIM_C2_HOST)/party" | Out-Null } catch {}
Write-Host 'cortexsim-edr-017-clickfix-lumma-loader-chain-modelled'

abiocs.name: ClickFix mshta Remote Fetch Parenting a Windows Command-Shell Loader Lineage
abiocs.description: A signed Microsoft mshta.exe carrying a remote/URL argument parents a cmd.exe or powershell.exe loader stage. mshta and cmd are both legitimate; the ABIOC anchors on the lineage (signed-binary-proxy remote fetch spawning an interpreter loader) rather than any known-bad string, catching the ClickFix post-paste loader hand-off that a static rule keyed on a single binary would miss.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = "mshta.exe"
| filter actor_process_command_line contains "http" or actor_process_command_line contains ".co/" or actor_process_command_line contains "=+"
| filter action_process_image_name in ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe")
| comp count() as loader_spawns by agent_hostname, actor_process_command_line, action_process_image_name
| filter loader_spawns >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_command_line, action_process_image_name, loader_spawns
abiocs.causality_anchor: User paste via RunMRU under explorer.exe -> mshta.exe remote fetch -> cmd.exe/powershell.exe loader lineage, anchored to the mshta signed-binary-proxy parent.

abiocs.name: AV and EDR Product Discovery via tasklist Piped to findstr in a Loader Lineage
abiocs.description: A cmd/mshta-parented lineage runs tasklist piped to findstr searching for security-product process names (opssvc, wrsa, bdservicehost, SophosHealth, AvastUI, AVGUI, nsWscSvc, ekrn). The commands are benign admin tools; the ABIOC fires on the security-software-discovery intent inside a loader lineage, anchored to the parent that spawned the probe.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = "findstr.exe"
| filter action_process_command_line contains "opssvc" or action_process_command_line contains "wrsa" or action_process_command_line contains "bdservicehost" or action_process_command_line contains "SophosHealth" or action_process_command_line contains "AvastUI" or action_process_command_line contains "AVGUI" or action_process_command_line contains "nsWscSvc" or action_process_command_line contains "ekrn"
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("cmd.exe", "mshta.exe", "PartyContinued.exe")
| comp count() as av_probe by agent_hostname, action_process_command_line
| filter av_probe >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, action_process_command_line, av_probe
abiocs.causality_anchor: Loader cmd.exe/mshta.exe lineage -> tasklist -> findstr filtering on security-product process names, anchored to the loader parent.

abiocs.name: extrac32 CAB Unpack into a Masqueraded Signed AutoIt3 Interpreter Running an a3x Script
abiocs.description: The flagship grouping ABIOC. It requires TWO distinct loader stages under ONE non-cmd causality owner (mshta.exe / extrac32.exe / PartyContinued.exe) inside the window: extrac32.exe unpacking a Cabinet archive delivered under a benign extension AND a validly-signed AutoIt3 interpreter running under a NON-standard image name (e.g. Slovenia.com instead of autoit3.exe). Signer says AutoIt, filename does not — that masquerade PLUS a second distinct stage sharing the lineage is what the ABIOC scores (filter distinct_stages >= 2), so a lone extrac32 /E CAB extraction or a single renamed binary does NOT trip it. cmd.exe is deliberately excluded as a causality owner because it is the CGO for enormous benign volume (routine CAB extraction, legitimately compiled AutoIt tools). This is the MODEL-ONLY detection a full (destructive) detonation of the masqueraded signed AutoIt3 stage would raise; SIM-EDR-017 runs the extrac32 unpack for real but models the AutoIt3 masquerade with a SAFE-MODE marker, so the pair does not assert this grouping fires under SAFE-MODE.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter (action_process_image_name = "extrac32.exe" and action_process_command_line contains "/E") or (action_process_signature_vendor contains "AutoIt" and action_process_image_name not in ("autoit3.exe", "autoit3_x64.exe"))
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name in ("mshta.exe", "extrac32.exe", "PartyContinued.exe")
| comp count_distinct(action_process_image_name) as distinct_stages by agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name
| filter distinct_stages >= 2
| sort desc distinct_stages
| fields agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_image_name, distinct_stages
abiocs.causality_anchor: mshta fetch -> cmd loader -> extrac32 unpack of a non-.cab archive (Boat.pst) + copy /b reconstruction -> validly-signed AutoIt3 running under a renamed image (Slovenia.com) against an .a3x script; the ABIOC requires at least TWO distinct loader stages (extrac32 unpack AND renamed signed-AutoIt3 exec) sharing one non-cmd causality owner before it groups them into a single Lumma-loader incident.

xql_queries.name: extrac32 Unpack and Renamed AutoIt3 Interpreter Execution Surfaced
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 900)
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = "extrac32.exe" or (action_process_signature_vendor contains "AutoIt" and action_process_image_name != "autoit3.exe")
| comp count() as surfaced by agent_hostname, action_process_image_name
| filter surfaced >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, action_process_image_name, surfaced

xql_queries.name: tasklist to findstr Security-Product Discovery Command Line
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 900)
| filter action_process_image_name in ("tasklist.exe", "findstr.exe")
| filter action_process_command_line contains "opssvc" or action_process_command_line contains "wrsa" or action_process_command_line contains "SophosHealth" or action_process_command_line contains "AvastUI"
| comp count() as probes by agent_hostname
| filter probes >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, probes

xql_queries.name: Loader Stager Fetch and Lumma C2 Egress on the Network Plane
xql_queries.query:
dataset = network_story
| filter dst_host contains "r2.dev" or dst_host = "sumeriavgv.digital" or dst_host = "iplogger.co"
| comp count() as egress_events by agent_hostname, dst_host
| filter egress_events >= 1
| fields agent_hostname, dst_host, egress_events

correlation_rules.name: ClickFix Lumma-Loader Chain — mshta-to-AutoIt3 Causality Stitch (EDR + NDR)
correlation_rules.logic: ABIOC(AV and EDR Product Discovery via tasklist Piped to findstr in a Loader Lineage) AND (XQL(extrac32 Unpack and Renamed AutoIt3 Interpreter Execution Surfaced) OR XQL(Loader Stager Fetch and Lumma C2 Egress on the Network Plane)) on the same agent_hostname within the correlation window — fuses the real endpoint loader-lineage signal (the security-software-discovery burst and the benign extrac32 CAB unpack) with the network stager-fetch / Lumma C2 egress into ONE Lumma-loader incident spanning the EDR and NDR planes. The full mshta -> cmd -> extrac32 -> renamed-AutoIt3 causality chain (the model-only grouping ABIOC) is the narrative anchor; the correlation fires on the signals the SAFE-MODE run actually produces.

use_cases.name: ClickFix Interpreter-Depth Loader Chain Detection via Cortex ABIOC + Cross-Plane Stitch
use_cases.description: Cortex's auto-tuned Analytics Behavioral IOCs catch the post-paste ClickFix loader chain — mshta fetch, AV/EDR discovery, extrac32 CAB unpack, and a masqueraded signed AutoIt3 interpreter running an .a3x script — by scoring the causality chain rather than any single legitimate binary, and a correlation rule stitches the endpoint lineage with the network stager/C2 egress into a single Lumma-loader incident.

test_cases.objective: The real LOLBin telemetry the SAFE-MODE run produces (the tasklist|findstr AV-discovery burst and the benign extrac32 CAB unpack) is surfaced and stitched, while the masqueraded-AutoIt3 grouping ABIOC + full causality chain are documented as the model-only detections a destructive detonation would raise.

preventive_controls: Disable or restrict the Win+R RunMRU / clipboard-paste-to-run path via policy and user training so the ClickFix paste never reaches an interpreter.
Block or tightly constrain mshta.exe and extrac32.exe execution for standard users via WDAC / AppLocker — both are LOLBins with no routine end-user need.
Enforce signed-and-expected-name execution policy so a signed AutoIt3 binary renamed to an arbitrary name (e.g. Slovenia.com) is blocked, not just alerted.
detection_engineering: Let Cortex auto-tune ABIOCs against per-process lineage, signer, and command-line intent rather than hand-authoring static rules for each legitimate LOLBin in the chain.
Alert on a signed binary whose signer vendor (AutoIt) does not match its on-disk image name — the renamed-interpreter masquerade tell.
Alert on tasklist piped to findstr filtering on security-product process names inside a mshta/cmd loader lineage.
Correlate the endpoint LOLBin lineage with NDR egress to pub-*.r2.dev stagers and Lumma C2 (sumeriavgv[.]digital) into one incident.
